system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: AgentMD performs tool selection (with MedCPT and Prompt #4), tool computation (with Prompt #5), and finally generates the answer.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; prompts are numbered per stage and filled with patient note and selected tool. The linked repo is MedCPT (retriever), not the AgentMD harness.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: AgentMD first retrieves the top 10 most relevant calculators to the patient note using MedCPT, a foundation model for embedding biomedical texts, and then selects the eligible tool with LLMs.
env_context_strategy.evidence_locator: paper Results, Applying RiskCalcs to Patient Notes
env_context_strategy.note: Retrieval selects calculator tools, not environment/repo context; this is the closest value.

context_compaction.note: The paper does not describe history management, and no AgentMD code is available. The MedCPT repo is not the harness.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the Python interpreter returns the printed results or error messages when executing the code that
observation_format.evidence_locator: paper Results, Applying RiskCalcs to Patient Notes

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The Python Interpreter runs all the code blocks in the AgentMD response and returns either the successful running results or error messages
tool_call_format.evidence_locator: paper Online Methods, AgentMD Tool Computation

tool_count.note: The only tool is a Python interpreter calling RiskCalcs functions. No tool schema is available to count.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: AgentMD uses the calculator by interacting with a Python interpreter
edit_primitive.evidence_locator: paper Online Methods, AgentMD Tool Computation
edit_primitive.note: The domain is not file editing. This is paper-only and the value is the closest fit.

tool_schema_source.note: RiskCalcs tools are LLM-generated Python functions with documentation. Their schema source is not a listed value and no code is available.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; there is no dependency or config surface to inspect.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: including three main steps: selection, computation, and summarization
loop_primitives.evidence_locator: paper Results, Applying RiskCalcs to Patient Notes
loop_primitives.note: The fixed pipeline is selection, then computation, then summarization. The computation step is a ReAct-style loop with the interpreter.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: AgentMD analyzes the patient information, extracts or infers the needed parameters, and passes them to call the calculator function
planning_granularity.evidence_locator: paper Online Methods, AgentMD Tool Computation

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a novel language agent capable of curating and applying clinical calculators

delegation_mechanism.note: Paper only; no agent factory is available.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The returned message from the Python Interpreter is then appended to the AgentMD messages
short_term_state.evidence_locator: paper Online Methods, AgentMD Tool Computation

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: culminating in the assembly of a repository of structured risk calculator tools (RiskCalcs)
long_term_memory.note: RiskCalcs is a persistent, LLM-made tool library reused across runs.

self_verification.note: At inference time only interpreter errors are fed back. During tool creation, GPT-4 verifies drafted calculators with Prompt #3; that is an offline llm_judge for tool making, not run-time verification.

retry_policy.note: Code re-tries on error are step-level, not task-level retries.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The tool computation loop will end once AgentMD generates a message that starts with a pre-defined text span “Summary: ”
termination_condition.evidence_locator: paper Online Methods, AgentMD Tool Computation

execution_isolation.note: The interpreter sandbox is not described.

replayability.note: Temperature is 0 for deterministic outputs, but no replay facility is described.

eval_hooks.note: The RiskQA evaluation is described, but no harness code is available. The MedCPT repo has evals/ for the retriever only.

target_domain.evidence_quote: AgentMD: Empowering Language Agents for Risk Prediction with Large-Scale Clinical Tool Learning
target_domain.note: The domain is clinical risk prediction.

open_source.evidence_quote: We will publicly release the code and data used in AgentMD upon publication.
open_source.note: The linked repo, ncbi/MedCPT, is only the retriever component, not the harness.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: AgentMD employs an LLM-agnostic framework capable of selecting, computing, and summarizing the results
model_agnostic.note: Experiments used only Azure OpenAI GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: We will publicly release the code and data used in AgentMD upon publication.

first_release_date.note: The paper v1 date (arXiv 2402.13225, Feb 2024) is not stated in the evidence text.

pinned_version.note: There is no AgentMD repo. The evidence bundle pins MedCPT main 11e129be7410 (2024-03-24), a component only.

stars.note: There is no AgentMD repo. The component MedCPT has 282 stars per the evidence header.
